metadata.description: Curated, source-verified knowledge base of the Python quantitative-finance library ecosystem, packaged as Agent Skills.

plugins.name: fin-core
plugins.description: US/global quant stack: market data sourcing and engineering, SEC/macro point-in-time data, backtesting engines, broker APIs, signals, factors, portfolio construction, risk analytics, backtest validation, derivatives pricing — plus the research-integrity guards that keep a backtest honest.

plugins.name: fin-china
plugins.description: China A-share / Greater China quant stack: akshare, tushare, baostock, efinance, adata, mootdx, jqdatasdk, rqdatac, Wind, plus vnpy / qlib / RQAlpha / tqsdk and the A-share-specific traps (qfq look-ahead, T+1, price limits, suspension, 公告日 vs 报告期).

plugins.name: fin-asia
plugins.description: Asia-Pacific ex-mainland-China: Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, India, Singapore and Australia — futu-api, tigeropen, shioaji, FinMind, J-Quants, pykrx, FinanceDataReader, kiteconnect and the date-keyed regime changes (Korea's short-selling bans, India's T+1/SEBI overhaul, the 2022 TSE restructuring) that silently break backtests.

plugins.name: fin-crypto
plugins.description: Crypto market data and execution: ccxt, cryptofeed, python-binance, freqtrade, jesse, hummingbot — and the 24/7-market assumptions that break equity-derived tooling.

plugins.name: fin-llm
plugins.description: LLM- and ML-for-finance: agent frameworks (TradingAgents, FinRobot, RD-Agent, FinGPT), reinforcement learning and deep learning for trading, finance MCP servers, and the published evidence on whether any of it survives lookahead leakage, transaction costs, and multiple-testing correction.
